incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: abnormal prefix cache miss surge for /api/v1/generate (service=runtime, region=us-west-2). Auto-mitigation triggered: fallback routing to backup model pool. Link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/1962004321

Ana (sre-oncall): I'm on it. seeing a jump in prefix-miss-rate from ~6% -> 48% starting 1962004200. Impacting tail latency and token cost.

Mike (prod-eng): Confirmed. frontend spike in error budget consumption. Some customers reporting slow responses. How widespread?

Sofia (ml-infra): looking at KV cache metrics. The prefix hit-rate graph shows a sharp drop aligned with a deploy at 1962004150. Possible cache invalidation misfire. Query I ran: `sum(rate(prefix_cache_hits[5m])) / sum(rate(prefix_cache_requests[5m]))`

Ana (sre-oncall): Can you paste the timeline? need numbers for customer impact.

Sofia (ml-infra): timeline (minute buckets):
```
1962004080: hit_rate=0.94
1962004140: hit_rate=0.91
1962004200: hit_rate=0.57
1962004260: hit_rate=0.42
1962004320: hit_rate=0.38
1962004380: hit_rate=0.36
```

Sofia (ml-infra): Also seeing increased evictions on node accel-3 in pool-dedicated: `kv_evictions_total{node="accel-3"}` jumped x3.

Mike (prod-eng): That deploy at 1962004150 was the /cache-invalidation change (PR 8421) — I rolled the change but left a TTL override experiment flag enabled. Might be nuking prefixes.

Ana (sre-oncall): For live mitigation: 1) rollback TTL override to previous value 2) temporarily increase prefix cache shards to reduce eviction pressure 3) rewarm popular prefixes from snapshot. Which is fastest?

Sofia (ml-infra): Fastest is rollback of TTL flag and trigger rewarm job for top-500 prefixes. Rolling TTL rollback now.

deploy-bot: Starting rollback of feature-flag:cache-prefix-ttl-experiment to false. job_id=rb-1962004390

Mike (prod-eng): I'll kick off a rewarm job for top prefixes and route a small % of traffic to backup cache pool. Command: `./tools/warmer --list top-500 --target pool-b`

Ana (sre-oncall): Noted. Customer impact estimate: between 1962004200 and 1962004800, ~12k requests experienced >500ms extra delay; 93 requests timed out (>=5s). Will file incident severity update.

Sofia (ml-infra): Rollback confirm: feature-flag reverted at 1962004415. Evictions on accel-3 dropping but hit-rate still recovering. Rewarm started at 1962004460.

Mike (prod-eng): Pushed routing change to divert 10% to pool-b at 1962004480. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/1962004321/run-1 (shared).

Ana (sre-oncall): Good. Need log snippets that show invalidation events. Sofia, can you grep for `prefix_invalidate` around 1962004150?

Sofia (ml-infra): Pasting relevant lines:
```
1962004151 prefix_invalidate key="user:prefix:abc123" source=deploy-8421
1962004152 prefix_invalidate key="user:prefix:def456" source=deploy-8421
1962004153 prefix_invalidate bulk=1k source=deploy-8421
```

Sofia (ml-infra): Looks like the change accidentally sent a bulk invalidation for a tenant-wide prefix namespace.

Mike (prod-eng): Ugh. PR 8421 had a missing guard in the invalidation path. I missed the namespace check in review. Rolling patch incoming.

Ana (sre-oncall): Immediate mitigations in place. Next: 1) patch PR 8421 to add namespace guard, 2) run targeted rewarm for affected tenants, 3) add metric alert for bulk-invalidate rate, 4) post-mortem. Who owns each?

Mike (prod-eng): I'll own patch and validation tests. ETA 2h for patch + canary.

Sofia (ml-infra): I'll own rewarm and add a dashboard for shard-level evictions + prefix hit-rate.

Ana (sre-oncall): I'll update incident severity and customer comms. Also handing this to next oncall in 30m — @PagerDuty Bot please escalate handoff.

PagerDuty Bot: Handoff scheduled to oncall: @Jamal at 1962006200. Summary: prefix cache invalidation from deploy-8421 caused hit-rate drop; rollback + rewarm + routing to pool-b mitigations applied.

Jamal (oncall): (joined) Reviewing thread. Any outstanding customer escalations open?

Ana (sre-oncall): None open beyond initial support tickets. We're tracking regression tests to prevent this. Current status: hit-rate slowly climbing back (0.72 at 1962006200), evictions normalized.

Mike (prod-eng): Patch PR 8423 created with guard and unit tests. Will canary tomorrow morning across low-traffic region.

Sofia (ml-infra): Rewarm completed for top-500 prefixes at 1962006120. Observability note: add an alert if `bulk_invalidate_rate > 100/s` and `prefix_hit_rate < 0.6` sustained > 5m.

Ana (sre-oncall): Action items captured in incident doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/1962004321-routine. Will schedule RCA with eng/infra/ml. Closing oncall handoff now. :thumbsup:

Mike (prod-eng): apologies for the deploy oversight. Will add stronger pre-merge validation for invalidation endpoints.

Sofia (ml-infra): Good catch. recommend a periodic rewarm job for top prefixes so single invalidation can't cause broad cold start.

Ana (sre-oncall): Thanks team. If anything regresses ping this thread.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. severity: Sev2 -> monitoring. closed_by: Ana (sre-oncall) at 1962006337
